title: Object Storage: the tier meter quantity precision
content:
Object Storage the tier meter quantity precision is defined as follows: Meter quantity decimal places; integer.

| Contract tier | The tier meter quantity precision |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | the tier meter quantity precision: 6 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | the tier meter quantity precision: 6 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | the tier meter quantity precision: 6 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | the tier meter quantity precision: 6 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | the tier meter quantity precision: 6 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | the tier meter quantity precision: 6 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the the tier meter quantity precision entry is 6.
